ValidationRule.description: This rule makes sure the Phone Number field follows a prescribed format.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c), ER_Business_Unit__c ='BENELUX', NOT(REGEX( Phone ,"(^$)|^[+]?([0-9]*[/\\.\\s\\-\\(\\)]|[0-9]+){3,24}$")), NOT( $Profile.Name = "Integration Profile"), NOT(ISBLANK(Phone)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Pease fill in a valid phone number.
